svg.text: BTB — branch target buffer: lookup and update
Update (when stall = 0 and valid_input): if the row at pc_branch(5..2) is invalid or holds another tag, a
jump allocates it with counter 11 and a taken branch with counter 10 (weakly taken); a not-taken branch is
not allocated. If the row is this branch, a jr/jalr rewrites the target and a conditional branch steps the
counter up (taken) or down, saturating at 11 and 00. In fetch the inputs come registered from
